title: International Tourism Demand in Europe 2026 — LSG Research Note 02
description: Source-backed descriptive comparison of international and domestic tourist-accommodation demand growth in the European Union during the first half of 2026. Includes explicit Low Season Growth calculations derived from published Eurostat figures. This is descriptive analysis, not a forecast or an individual-hotel performance benchmark.
notes: Prepared for a standalone Zenodo dataset deposit. License intentionally not preselected.
